conbody.p: The selected artifact opens on the right (on a phone, in the Document pane). Its header carries the ref, the status, quality and priority chips, and Edit, History and Delete; below the title are its type, owner, verification method, the releases it is planned for (when it sets its own and the project plans target releases, such as MVP onwards), version and when it last changed, then the review step it can take next (Submit for review, Approve, …).

ul.li: Trace lists every artifact this one is linked to, ↑ above and ↓ below, with the link's type; a suspect link is marked in yellow. Click one to go to it.
Verification shows how many of the tests verifying it pass, a pass / fail / blocked bar, each test with its latest result, and the requirement's rollup.
Below them are the description (with Show impact →), the attributes, the figures and the full list of traceability links, where a link can be deleted.

conbody.p: On a phone the artifact ends in a bar under your thumb: Comment scrolls to its History, where the comment box is, and the review step forward (Submit for review, Approve) is the blue button beside it.
